title: Quakecraft
description: adds the Hypixel gamemode of quakecraft to your world!
body:
![golden hoe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f74d0093016083476385724d7dbf5cdb4f53136.png)
**QuakeCraft from Hypixel!**

This plugin adds the duel gamemode of Quakecraft from Hypixel but on your server and with more flexibility!

**Features**

- Railgun with visible particle/display trail
- Left click dash movement
- Configurable cooldowns, range, dash strength, hit radius, kill goal, and trail style
- Actionbar cooldown display
- Start countdown and sidebar scoreboard
- Multiple map support through map-specific spawnpoints
- Three game modes: Normal, Random Guns, and Gun Game
- Gun Game final melee win condition
- Debuff command if someone is too good
- Fall damage disabled during gameplay
- Nametags always visible even if the player is crouching
- Configurable spawn invincibility

**Requirements:**

Paper server for Minecraft Java 1.21+
Java 21 or newer

**Install**

Stop the server.
Put QuakeCraft-1.21.11.jar in the server plugins folder.
Start the server.
Run /qc gui or /qc spawnpoint [block] to begin setup.
When replacing the jar, restart the server. For normal config edits, use /qc reload.

**Quick Setup**

/qc spawnpoint [block]
/qc map [block used for spawnpoint]
/qc mode normal
/qc start

Place multiple spawnpoint blocks around the arena before starting.

How maps work:
Use the same type of block for one map and a different type for another.
Each unique block will create a new map that is named based off the spawnpoint block.
